title: 第十三章 扑不灭的大火越烧越旺第十四章 杀人诛心铁布衫圆满
slug: 修炼一天抵十年莫欺老年穷
lines: 方家的车队很快驶入此地。
方如龙、方如虎、方栋，及一群保镖，全都从汽车中走出来，看向了眼前的一处巨大工厂。
方栋脸色惊异，有些不可置信。
方如龙出口回应，道：“只不过十五年前发生了一场大火，将整个胡同都给烧没了，方圆好几里都变成了平地，之后这里就建了工厂。”
“打听一下吧，他既然说他住在这里，那么他之前肯定来过，说不定四周有人见过他。”
接下来他们分散开来，开始打探消息。
林玄一路紧赶，终于，再次来到韩总兵家中。
他口中轻轻吐出一口浊气，强行稳定心绪，迈步走入。
林玄声音涩哑，强行挤出微笑，看向轮椅上的老人。
赵秀珠正在推着韩母散步，闻言顿时回过头来。
看来林玄没有去找仁义堂麻烦。
林玄沉吟一二，道：“我想知道十五年前林家老宅，那场大火的事情。”
随后韩母轻轻一叹，道：“我原本是不想告诉你的，怕你知道之后，心力交瘁，难以承受，我曾派人多方打听过，那场大火之下，林家老宅四十二口人，似乎...无一生还。”
林家老宅的人，肯定是被人杀了！
不然单凭大火，怎能烧死以武传家的林家之人？
“当时那场大火没人知道原因，只知道烧了三天三夜，其间不知道多少人去救火，但是水浇下去却根本没用，越烧越旺，极其诡异，就连救火之人也被烧死了不知道多少，
更加古怪的是，三天后的凌晨，那大火就自动熄灭了，连一点余温都没剩下，第二天一早，林家老宅所在的整个胡同，就直接化为了一片平地。”
林玄脸色彻底阴沉下去。
content_en:
West of the old town.
The original location of Jiqing Hutong.
The Fang family's motorcade quickly drove in.
The car stops.
Fang Rulong, Fang Ruhu, Fang Dong, and a group of bodyguards all got out of the car and looked at the huge factory in front of them.
"Is this Jiqing Hutong?"
Fang Dong looked surprised and a little in disbelief.
"Yes, this is the former Jiqing Hutong."
Fang Rulong responded, "It's just that there was a fire fifteen years ago, which burned down the entire alley and turned it into flat land for several miles. After that, a factory was built here."
"Then where is the veteran now?"
Fang Dong looked blank.
"Let's ask around. Since he said he lives here, he must have been here before. Maybe someone around has seen him."
Fang Rulong said.
"Yes."
Fang Dong nodded quickly.
Next they spread out and began to inquire for information.
...
far away.
Lin Xuan hurried all the way and finally came to Han Zongbing's home again.
He let out a breath of turbid air, forced himself to calm down, and walked in.
"Aunt..."
Lin Xuan's voice was hoarse, and he forced a smile and looked at the old man in the wheelchair.
Zhao Xiuzhu was pushing Han Mu for a walk, and immediately turned around when she heard this.
"Xiao Xuan, you are back..."
The two laughed.
It seems that Lin Xuan did not go to Renyi Hall to cause trouble.
Then they will feel relieved.
Lin Xuan pondered for a moment and said, "I want to know about the fire in the Lin family's old house fifteen years ago."
"Fifteen years ago?"
Both of them looked moved.
Then Mother Han sighed softly and said: "I didn't want to tell you originally, because I was afraid that you would be exhausted mentally and physically after knowing it, and it would be unbearable. I have sent people to inquire about it. It seems that... none of the forty-two people in the Lin family's old house survived the fire."
"No one will survive!"
Lin Xuan's eyelids twitched.
impossible!
This is absolutely impossible!
The people in the Lin family's old house must have been killed!
Otherwise, how could the fire alone burn to death the members of the Lin family who inherited the family name through martial arts?
"No one knew the cause of the fire at that time. They only knew that it burned for three days and three nights. During that time, an unknown number of people went to put out the fire, but it was useless to pour water on it. It burned more and more intensely. It was extremely strange. Even the people who put out the fire were burned to death.
What's even more bizarre is that in the early morning three days later, the fire went out automatically, without even a trace of residual warmth remaining. Early the next morning, the entire alley where the Lin family's old house was located was reduced to flat ground. "
Mother Han said.
"Is that so?"
Lin Xuan's face turned completely gloomy.
Inextinguishable fire...
The more it burns, the more prosperous it is...
title_en: Chapter 13: The fire that cannot be extinguished is getting stronger and stronger Chapter 14: Killing people and killing people, the iron cloth shirt is perfect
